hits.tldr: Official Prettier plugin automatically sorts Tailwind CSS classes in recommended order across editors.
Tailwind CSS scans source as plain text, so you must use complete class names and map dynamic values to predefined class lists.
Tailwind converts underscores to spaces in arbitrary values, with exceptions for URLs and escaped underscores.
Use unprefixed utilities for mobile styles; prefixes like sm: apply at breakpoints, not to small screens.
Control gradient interpolation mode using modifiers like srgb, hsl, oklab, oklch, longer, shorter, increasing, or decreasing.
